### SendOptions {#SendOptions}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">SendOptions</code></div>

Options of `send`.

```ts sdk-signature
interface SendOptions {
  acknowledge?: readonly FindingCode[];
  simulation?: SimulationForSend;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>acknowledge?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">readonly <a href="#FindingCode">FindingCode</a>[]</span> | The warning codes the caller has seen and accepts for this transaction (the meaning of each code is on the keys of `FINDINGS`). `send` refuses (FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED) while `prepared.checks`, or the findings of `simulation`, hold a `warning` whose code is not listed. - `warningCodes(prepared, simulation)` gives exactly the codes this   transaction carries: pass it once those warnings have been shown to   whoever owns the funds. - A fixed list states a policy; a listed code with no matching warning   is ignored. - It is always a list of codes. There is no `true` or `'all'`: a value   that would also cover warnings nobody has seen is not accepted, and a   string that is not a finding code is PAYLOAD_INVALID (a typo must not   pass for an acknowledgement). - `info` findings never need one. For autocompletion of the codes one kind of transaction can carry, annotate with `FindingCodeFor<'withdraw'>[]`. |
| <code>simulation?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#SimulationForSend">SimulationForSend</a></span> | The [`experimental.simulate`](../experimental.md#simulate) result for this `prepared`. Its warnings (SIMULATION_REVERTED, SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH, SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE, SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE, SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT) then need acknowledging like the prepared ones. A simulation of another request is PAYLOAD_INVALID. |

</div>

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/send.ts#L75">source</a></p>

| <code>timeoutMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> | Default 180 s for an account, 30 min for a contract wallet. |
| <code>confirmations?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |

### FindingSeverity {#FindingSeverity}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">FindingSeverity</code></div>

`warning`: `send` needs it acknowledged. `info`: for the record.

```ts sdk-signature
type FindingSeverity = 'warning' | 'info';
```

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/findings.ts#L13">source</a></p>

### FindingGroup {#FindingGroup}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">FindingGroup</code></div>

- `unchecked`: a safety check could not run (no data source, a failed
  read). Nothing is known to be wrong; nothing was shown to be right.
- `risk`: the transaction will do something that is often not intended.
- `note`: information; never needs acknowledgement.
- `claim`: an [`incentives.preflight`](../incentives.md#preflight) issue (never on a [`Prepared`](./send.md#Prepared)).

```ts sdk-signature
type FindingGroup = 'unchecked' | 'risk' | 'note' | 'claim';
```
